name: What documents do I need to prepare before seeking pre-construction contract guidance?

mainEntity.name: What documents do I need to prepare before seeking pre-construction contract guidance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before seeking guidance, it is helpful to gather any preliminary documents you've received from the developer, such as brochures, price lists, floor plans, and especially any draft purchase agreements or reservation forms. Having these ready allows our team to quickly review the initial terms and provide targeted advice. Consider what specific features or terms are most important to you, as this will inform areas for negotiation. This preparation helps streamline the review process and ensures we focus on your key priorities and concerns from the outset.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare any developer documents like brochures, price lists, floor plans, and draft agreements. Also, consider your key priorities and concerns to streamline the guidance process.
